proposal.summary: MXsecurity before 1.0.1 has an authentication bypass: a remote attacker may access the system when the web service authenticator uses insufficiently random values.
proposal.cwe_quote: if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.

PR.quote: A remote attacker might access the system

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm the issue by reviewing the web service authenticator's random value generation and entropy sources; backport or apply the vendor patch (upgrade to 1.0.1 or later) and rotate affected credentials/sessions.

evidence_quotes.quote: There is a vulnerability in MXsecurity versions prior to 1.0.1
can be exploited to bypass authentication. A remote attacker might access the system
if the web service authenticator has insufficient random values.
